quick_start_qwen3_0_6b_megatron_vllm_asc.note: Run 32881976946 / job 97913402004: dies in vLLMHttpServer.launch_server -> create_engine_config before step 1. 'pydantic_core ValidationError ... max_num_batched_tokens (8192) is smaller than max_model_len (40960)'. ROOT CAUSE: PR #7508 (82e35343, merged 2026-08-25 03:58 UTC) fixed build_cli_args_from_config to emit --no-<flag> for Optional[bool] vLLM engine args set to False, so enable_chunked_prefill=False now reaches vLLM for the first time (it had been silently dropped since #6900). verl auto-derives max_model_len from max_position_embeddings (40960 for Qwen3-0.6B, vllm_async_server.py:995) while max_num_batched_tokens stays at its 8192 default (workers/config/rollout.py:196); with chunked prefill off, vLLM requires budget >= max_model_len. Emitted args prove it: '--max_model_len 40960', '--no-enable_chunked_prefill', '--max_num_batched_tokens 8192', followed by vLLM's 'This model does not officially support disabling chunked prefill'. Isolation: all four quick_start jobs green Aug 24 (fc6ca747, pre-#7508); on Aug 25 only the two vLLM ones broke, the two sglang ones on the same runner pool stayed green. FIX: branch ci-fix/quickstart-vllm-chunked-prefill (head eeb1813a) on fork lxb007981/verl - drops the stale flag from 4 Ascend NPU scripts + adds a fail-fast branch to vLLMHttpServer._validate_configs. PR NOT opened: PAT 403 on gh pr create (both GraphQL and REST), same kit blocker as 2026-08-20; body saved at state/pending-prs/ci-fix_quickstart-vllm-chunked-prefill.body.md, audit at .../ci-fix_quickstart-vllm-chunked-prefill.md.
